extDescription.message: Navigate the web using only head and eye movements. An accessibility tool.

popupCameraHint.message: If the camera is blocked, click "Setup" and allow it, then start again.

popupVoiceUnavailable.message: unavailable, start HeadNav and try again

popupMicHint.message: If the microphone is blocked, click "Setup" and allow it, then test again.

popupLocalVoiceHint.message: Local voice is not installed. Click "Setup" to install it or to choose online.

errorFramesStalled.message: No camera frames are being processed. Try stopping and starting again.

setupIntro.message: Someone can help with this page once. After that, HeadNav is used hands-free.

setupCameraText.message: HeadNav needs your camera to read head and eye movements. All processing happens locally in your browser — no video ever leaves your machine.

setupMicrophoneText.message: Used only for voice dictation, and only while you dictate.

setupOnlineText.message: Usually more accurate, works in more languages, needs no download and works on any computer with Chrome. Needs internet, and Chrome sends your audio to Google to turn it into text.

setupLocalText.message: Your audio never leaves this computer, even without internet. Needs a one-time download of the language package, may be less accurate, uses this computer's processor and only works in recent Chrome versions and some languages.

setupPermissionDenied.message: blocked. Allow it in Chrome's site settings for this extension

setupCameraGrantedHint.message: You can close this tab and start HeadNav from the toolbar.

setupMicrophoneGrantedHint.message: Voice dictation can be used while HeadNav is on.

setupLocalVoiceUnavailable.message: not available for this language in this Chrome

setupLocalVoiceUnsupported.message: not supported by this Chrome version

setupGuideText.message: When everything is ready, see what each gesture does.

guideIntro.message: HeadNav moves a cursor with your head and clicks when you hold it still. These are the gestures and what each one does.

guideDwellGesture.message: Hold the cursor on a link, button or field for 1.5 s

guideDwellAction.message: Clicks. A magnet pulls the cursor onto small targets. To click the same target again, move away and come back.

guideBackGesture.message: Close your left eye for 2 s, keeping the other one open

guideBackAction.message: Goes back to the previous page.

guideBackCursor.message: Blue ring with ←; the cursor holds still during the gesture

guideForwardGesture.message: Close your right eye for 2 s, keeping the other one open

guideForwardAction.message: Goes forward to the next page.

guidePauseAction.message: Pauses clicking; repeat the gesture to click again. The cursor, eye gestures and scrolling keep working.

guidePauseCursor.message: Purple ring; while paused, a grey cursor with ⏸

guideScrollGesture.message: Hold the cursor in the top or bottom strip of the screen for 2 s

guideScrollAction.message: Scrolls the page; the closer to the edge, the faster.

guideVoiceStep1.message: Hold the cursor on a text field, such as the YouTube search box: the voice typing panel opens.

guideVoiceStep2.message: Hold it on "Allow and speak" (online mode) or "Speak" (local mode).

guideVoiceStep3.message: Speak. The text appears as you talk, and the microphone turns off by itself when you stop (15 s at most).

guideVoiceStep4.message: Check the text and hold the cursor on "Search" (search fields) or "Insert" (other fields). "Speak again" starts over and "Cancel" discards it.

guideVoiceNote.message: While the microphone listens, gestures are paused and the cursor turns red with 🎤, so speaking never clicks or navigates by accident.

guideSignalFace.message: Grey cursor with ?: your face is not being seen, so the cursor stops and nothing is clicked.

guideSignalVoice.message: Red cursor with 🎤: the microphone is listening.

guideSignalBadges.message: On the HeadNav icon, CAM means the camera is on and a red MIC means the microphone is on.

guidePrivacyVideo.message: Camera video never leaves your computer, and there is no telemetry.

guidePrivacyVoice.message: With local voice the audio stays on your computer. With online voice the audio goes to Google, and HeadNav asks for your authorization every time.

guideSetupText.message: On the setup page: allow the camera, allow the microphone (optional), choose online or local voice and install the local voice if you will use it. Then click Start on the HeadNav icon in the Chrome toolbar.

panelOnlineNotice.message: To turn your speech into text, your voice is sent to Google. The camera video stays on this computer.

panelLocalNotice.message: Your voice stays on this computer.

panelErrorNoSpeech.message: I didn't hear anything. Try speaking a little closer to the microphone.

panelErrorNetwork.message: There is no internet connection, so online voice typing is unavailable.

panelErrorMicBlocked.message: The microphone is blocked for HeadNav. Ask your helper to allow it on the setup page.

panelErrorNoMicrophone.message: No microphone was found, or another app is using it.

panelErrorLocalUnavailable.message: Local voice is not installed. Ask your helper to install it on the setup page, or to switch to online.

panelErrorUnsupported.message: This Chrome does not support voice typing.
